name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Research Student Scholarships
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
fundingSummary: Fully funded · 100% tuition & admission fees · ¥143,000–¥145,000/month living stipend · Return airfare
bangladeshEligibility: Citizens of Bangladesh born on or after April 2, 1992
academicCriteria: Bachelor's degree or higher with high academic standing (CGPA 3.25+ or First Class)
englishRequirement: Good command of English or Japanese; language exams administered by Embassy of Japan in Dhaka
subjectRestrictions: Fields of study that the applicant majored in at university or related fields available in Japan
deadlineTimezone: Embassy recommendation round opens April/May annually at Embassy of Japan in Bangladesh
applicationRoute: Embassy track through Embassy of Japan in Dhaka (written test & interview) OR University recommendation track
separateAdmission: Yes—provisional acceptance letter from Japanese university required after passing primary screening
documents: Application form, placement preference form, field of study and research plan, transcripts, recommendation letters, health certificate
sourceDataset: EG Global Europe & World Intake Research 2026-10-06

overallSummary.cost: 100% full tuition fees, matriculation fees, and entrance examination fees waived at Japanese national universities.
overallSummary.benefits: Monthly stipend of ¥143,000 (Research/Master's) to ¥145,000 (PhD), round-trip economy airfare Dhaka–Tokyo, and 6 months intensive Japanese language course.
overallSummary.other: No bond or return requirement. Grantees can transition into competitive post-study employment in Japan's advanced technology sector.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS - Graduate Degree)
provider: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Republic of Korea
fundingSummary: Fully funded · 100% tuition fee · 1,000,000 KRW/month living allowance · Return airfare · Medical insurance · Settlement allowance
bangladeshEligibility: Citizens of Bangladesh whose parents are not citizens of Korea
academicCriteria: CGPA above 80% percentile (CGPA 3.2+ on 4.0 scale); under 40 years of age
englishRequirement: TOEFL, IELTS, or institutional equivalent; TOPIK bonus score if applicable
subjectRestrictions: All fields offered by participating Korean universities (excluding medicine/architecture exceeding regular duration)
deadlineTimezone: Embassy track deadline early March; University track deadline March–April
applicationRoute: Embassy track (via Korean Embassy in Dhaka) OR University track (direct to 1 Korean university)
documents: Application form, personal statement, statement of purpose, 2 letters of recommendation, bachelor's degree certificate and transcript, apostille/attestation
sourceDataset: EG Global Europe & World Intake Research 2026-10-06

overallSummary.cost: 100% tuition covered for the entire 2-year Master's or 3-year PhD degree.
overallSummary.benefits: 1,000,000 KRW/month living allowance, round-trip airfare, 200,000 KRW settlement allowance, medical insurance, and 1 year fully funded Korean language training.
overallSummary.other: Must achieve TOPIK Level 3 during the mandatory 1-year language course before entering degree program.

name: Türkiye Bursları (Turkey Government Scholarships)
provider: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB), Republic of Turkey
fundingSummary: Fully funded · 100% university tuition · Monthly stipend · Free accommodation · 1-year Turkish course · Return flight · Health insurance
bangladeshEligibility: Citizens of all countries including Bangladesh
academicCriteria: Minimum academic achievement: 70% for Bachelor's, 75% for Master's/PhD; age limits: under 21 for UG, under 30 for Master's, under 35 for PhD
englishRequirement: Institutional requirement for English-taught programs (IELTS/TOEFL); Turkish language not required before arrival
subjectRestrictions: Wide range of disciplines across Turkish public and private foundation universities
deadlineTimezone: Annual application window runs 10 January to 20 February
applicationRoute: Single online application via Türkiye Bursları Application System (tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr)
separateAdmission: No—university placement and scholarship award are combined in one decision
documents: Diploma or temporary certificate, official transcript, passport copy, national exam / international exam scores (if any), letter of intent
sourceDataset: EG Global Europe & World Intake Research 2026-10-06

overallSummary.cost: 100% university tuition fees fully covered for the entire program.
overallSummary.benefits: Monthly stipend (TL 3,500 for UG, TL 5,000 for Master's, TL 6,500 for PhD), free student dormitory accommodation, one-year Turkish language course, round-trip flight ticket, and health insurance.
overallSummary.other: Includes complete university placement. Very popular among Bangladeshi students with straightforward online application.

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
provider: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), NTU, NUS, SUTD
fundingSummary: Fully funded · 100% tuition waiver for 4 years · Monthly stipend SGD 2,700–3,200 · Airfare grant SGD 1,500 · Settling-in allowance SGD 1,000
bangladeshEligibility: International graduates with passion for biomedical, physical sciences, or engineering research
academicCriteria: Excellent undergraduate or master's academic results (CGPA 3.5+ on 4.0 scale)
englishRequirement: Fluent written and spoken English (IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90 recommended)
subjectRestrictions: Biomedical Sciences, Computing & Information Sciences, Engineering & Technology, Physical Sciences
deadlineTimezone: August 2027 intake deadline 01 January 2027 at 23:59 SGT
applicationRoute: Direct online application via A*STAR SINGA application portal
separateAdmission: No—award application directly coordinates with chosen university (NUS, NTU, or SUTD)
documents: Bachelor's and Master's academic transcripts, 2 recommendation reports, passport copy, passport-sized photo
sourceDataset: EG Global Europe & World Intake Research 2026-10-06

overallSummary.cost: 100% tuition fees covered for up to 4 years of PhD studies at top-ranked universities (NUS/NTU/SUTD).
overallSummary.benefits: Monthly stipend of SGD 2,700 (increased to SGD 3,200 after passing Qualifying Examination), one-time airfare grant of SGD 1,500, and one-time settling-in allowance of SGD 1,000.
overallSummary.other: World-class research environment in Singapore. Collaborative research supervised by A*STAR researchers and university professors.

name: KAUST Fellowship (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
fundingSummary: Fully funded · 100% tuition support · Annual living stipend $20,000–$30,000 USD · Free housing · Medical/dental insurance · Relocation flights
bangladeshEligibility: All admitted students into MS and PhD programs at KAUST automatically receive the Fellowship
academicCriteria: High academic merit in STEM fields; Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.7 out of 4.0 (or top 10% of class)
englishRequirement: IELTS 6.5 (min 5.5 in all subscores) or TOEFL iBT 79
subjectRestrictions: Biological and environmental sciences, computer, electrical and mathematical sciences, physical sciences and engineering
deadlineTimezone: Round 1 closes early Jan 2027; Round 2 closes March 2027
applicationRoute: Direct online application through KAUST Admissions portal
separateAdmission: No—fellowship awarded automatically to all admitted graduate students
documents: Official university transcripts, statement of purpose, curriculum vitae, 3 letters of recommendation
sourceDataset: EG Global Europe & World Intake Research 2026-10-06

overallSummary.cost: 100% full tuition support and all university fees covered for the entire program duration.
overallSummary.benefits: Annual living allowance of $20,000 to $30,000 USD (net stipend), free private on-campus housing, comprehensive medical and dental insurance, and relocation airfare.
overallSummary.other: Unmatched research funding and cutting-edge facilities on the Red Sea coast. Automatic fellowship for 100% of admitted students.
